correctness.rationale: For k>=1 the selected divisors of 3*2^k have sum 4*2^k-2, exactly half the total. Multiplying a balanced divisor partition by every divisor of a coprime factor preserves equality. Factoring out the complete power of 2 and the unique factor of 3 proves both progression rules. All table starts have the claimed residues, and adding 18 each time preserves the variable summand's membership. The only uncovered odd targets above 983 are 1001 and 1019, both settled by the displayed exceptional decompositions. I independently enumerated paired divisors through 1200, doing exact subset-sum by remainders for the half containing n, and reconstructed the residue minima and the finite two- and three-sum sets. This confirmed 945 is the only odd Zumkeller number through 983, the six possible even summands below 38, and the absence of 38 from their two-sum set. Any decomposition of 983 must have exactly one odd summand, so the deficit 38 is decisive. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/local_exact_audit.py 1. The symbolic progression argument, not the finite computation, proves the infinite tail.
